integrity.proof_basis: Exhaustive spine-state and page-state classification, followed by an elementary perfect-matching analysis.
integrity.residual_literature_risk: The public abstract of the 2016 polynomial paper does not identify all standard graph families treated in its full text.

scientific.claim_scope: Exact all-cardinality polynomial, structural classification, total count, and minimum-layer classification.
limitations: The theorem excludes the boundary \(n=1\), which is the cycle \(C_4\).
The finite checker is only a regression test; the infinite-family result rests on the symbolic case proof.
An unindexed family-specific formula may exist, and the accessible 2016 paired-domination-polynomial source exposed only its abstract rather than its full standard-family list.
scientific.object: Paired-dominating sets of the square book \(B_n=K_{1,n}\mathbin{\square}P_2\) for \(n\ge2\).
